historical_claim: Colonial Yucatec Kaua per-birth-day source ascribes carpentry/weaving/making ability to Chuen-born persons (Bolles composite; earlier Barrera Vázquez translation reproduced in Thompson 1950 p80).
not_claimed: No known statistical relationship between birth day and modern craft practices, no living uninterrupted Yucatec birth-clock validation

primary_outcome.purpose: Approximate total hours spent in paid or unpaid tangible making over last 12 months
primary_outcome.wording_en: In the past 12 months, approximately how many hours have you spent making, building, decorating or repairing physical objects with your hands, including paid and unpaid activities? Examples include weaving, sewing, woodworking, pottery, carving, metalwork and similar crafts. Do not count ordinary cleaning, routine cooking or washing dishes.
primary_outcome.wording_fr: Au cours des 12 derniers mois, combien d’heures environ avez-vous consacrées à fabriquer, construire, décorer ou réparer des objets matériels de vos mains, dans le cadre d’activités rémunérées ou non ? Par exemple : tissage, couture, travail du bois, poterie, sculpture, travail des métaux et artisanat semblable. Ne comptez pas le ménage ordinaire, la cuisine courante ni la vaisselle.
primary_outcome.source_equivalence: PARTIAL: source speaks of roles/skills; modern recent hours is a measurable behavior proxy, not the historical same construct
primary_outcome.direction_predeclaration: Higher ordinal category for Chuen birthdays under ONE declared date-only rule

secondary_items.en: How much of the time you reported making or repairing objects was part of paid work or another income-producing activity?
secondary_items.why: The source names occupational crafts; paid versus unpaid share must not be ignored

secondary_items.en: During the past 12 months, was making, designing, constructing or repairing physical objects a regular part of your occupation or income-producing activities?
responses: Regularly but not my main occupation
secondary_items.why: Closer to historical artisan occupational role; distinct secondary outcome, not allowed to rescue negative primary

secondary_items.en: Have you ever received formal or informal training or apprenticeship in making, weaving, carpentry, sewing, metalwork, ceramics or another tangible craft?
secondary_items.why: Skill/occupation more literal than hours; different construct

secondary_items.en: Over the past 12 months, how much access did you have to the time, materials, workspace and physical ability needed for making or repairing objects?
Which category best describes your main work during the last 12 months?

values: Did not know Maya birth-day sign
Knew own day sign before study

consent_draft.en: This study examines whether one historical calendar-based model is associated with ordinary activities. Such predictions are not scientifically established, and this may not represent current Maya practice. Participation is voluntary; you may skip questions or withdraw. Birth information is stored separately from research responses, with restricted access.
consent_draft.source_disclosure_timing: Describe general historical calendar research in consent but do not reveal Chuen or expected craft answer before questionnaire response freeze

presentation.primary_response_option_order: ascending fixed ordinal order so numbers preserve magnitude
presentation.other_question_order: predeclared and fixed before participant answers, avoid hidden adaptive question selection
presentation.leakage_question_timing: prior Maya birth-day awareness asked after ordinary craft behavior items but before final response freeze

analysis_draft.calendar_model: GMT584283 proleptic Gregorian DATE-ONLY modern reconstruction, not living daykeeper reckoning
analysis_draft.test_one_sided: Chuen craft-hour ordinal scores greater than non-Chuen
analysis_draft.null: pre-committed matched/stratified permutation only if exchangeability justified by design
analysis_draft.alternate_correlations: listed sensitivity only; cannot choose best after outcomes
analysis_draft.nonastrology_controls: occupation/skills/access and age/region/language; one prespecified comparison for confirmatory status
